design-system-primitives.scope: Use maintained DWP and MUI primitives while preserving reference hierarchy, geometry, emphasis and control meaning.
design-system-primitives.rationale: Production code must use supported components instead of reference HTML internals.

runtime-data-values.scope: Live names, dates and counts may vary while locale, semantic state, line budget and information density remain equivalent.
runtime-data-values.rationale: Reference fixtures establish content intent rather than immutable enterprise records.

approved-local-media.scope: Use an approved local image with equivalent subject, crop, contrast and visual footprint when a reference asset is remote.
approved-local-media.rationale: Production evidence cannot depend on the reference export network hosts.

accessibility-semantics.scope: Add focus, labels, live-region semantics and target sizing without moving or hiding required visual landmarks.
accessibility-semantics.rationale: Runtime accessibility contracts are stronger than the visual reference markup.

dynamic-content-length.scope: Document length may reflect bounded live item counts while section order, first-viewport priority and all required landmarks remain.
dynamic-content-length.rationale: Full-page height can change with governed runtime content budgets.

reference-export-boundary.scope: Explain only canvas padding or truncation proven to come from the accepted export; it cannot excuse a missing product section.
reference-export-boundary.rationale: Accepted PNG height and pixel scale do not consistently equal a browser full-page capture.

permission-guard.scope: Keep unauthorized data absent while preserving the reference denial placement, unaffected regions and recovery guidance.
permission-guard.rationale: Production authorization must remain fail closed.
